capture.source: GET /api/v1/tracks/index from the engine composition root (build_config, apply_env_contract, prepare_layout, create_app) in a child interpreter over a StateWriter-hydrated data dir: tests/webui/capture_cmdk_index.py
capture.scenario: Five rows for the Cmd K v2 tests (CMDK-04, CMDK-05; Codex P1 on PR #6089, thread PRRT_kwDOSEvNd86rCuos): three present real mp3 copies (one a remix, two sharing an album), one local path that does not exist, and one tidal: streaming URI. Re-captured Tue 13 Oct 2026 for a reviewed index wire change: index rows now carry comments (CMDK-04, Codex P2 on #6089), and one row has a comment written through StateWriter.set_field; every other field is byte-identical to the first capture. Local file_path values are rewritten to <data_dir>/audio/<name> because the temp dir differs per run; no test reads them. Re-captured Tue 27 Oct 2026 for a reviewed index wire change (AGENT-31, PR #7594): TrackOut gained the optional `loudness` block, served on the single-track read and null on index rows. Re-captured Tue 27 Oct 2026 (Sol P1 #7594) with invented Lanternfall titles in place of a real song title. Re-captured Wed 28 Oct 2026 for merge of main and PR #7574 (QLTSCAN-02): each row's quality carries the QLT grade block (letter, checked, issues) together with main's loudness nulls and Lanternfall titles (OSSPUB-01). Re-captured Wed 4 Nov 2026 for a reviewed index wire change (PR #8598, cloud offload backend): each row gains the optional `offload` field, null here; every other field is unchanged. Re-captured Thu 5 Nov 2026 for reviewed index wire changes on af--set-rc (GRID-OCTAVE-02 and SRCFLAG-01): each row gains `bpm_disputed` (false), `bpm_alternatives` ([]), `bpm_pick` (null) and `source_flags` ([]); every other field is unchanged. Re-captured Thu 5 Nov 2026 for a reviewed index wire change (12042582bb, tempo stability in the grid-quality sidecar): each row gains the optional `analysis_hints` field and a `tempo` key in grid_quality, both null here; every other field is unchanged. Re-captured Fri 13 Nov 2026 for reviewed index wire changes merged to main (bundle PR #13607 and before): each row gains `color_id` (PR #10679), `tracklist_hidden` (NOWP-11487), `genre_family` and `genre_family_color` (issue #11310, e1a18307d4), `remote_stem_status` (PR #12736), `deck_load_refusal` (PR #12142) and the LIBEDIT-9179 edit shape (`edit_id`, `in_ms`, `out_ms`, `fx`, `edit_label`, `created_by`, `is_edit`, `valid`; PR #9179), all at their defaults here; `comments` is unchanged; every other field is unchanged. Re-captured Fri 13 Nov 2026 for a reviewed index wire change (PR #13803, Date Added column): each row gains `date_added`, the earlier of tracks.created_at and rekordbox's own date; the capture now pins every row's created_at to 2026-10-13 so the value is the same on every run; every other field is unchanged.
capture.immutable: Do not regenerate or rewrite this capture to make a test pass. Re-capture only for a reviewed change to the index wire shape.
